definitions.log_rv_ratio_28_180: log(rv_28 / rv_180); rv_h = sample std (ddof=1) of the last h daily log returns; no annualization inside the ratio
definitions.signed_path_efficiency_56: (close_t - close_(t-56)) / sum(abs(daily close changes)) over exactly 56 completed steps (57 close observations)
definitions.autocorr_lag1_56: lag-1 Pearson autocorrelation of the last 56 daily log returns; only finite pairs used, never NaN-as-0

jm_model.loss: squared Euclidean distance on standardized features
jm_model.objective: min_{mu,s} sum_t l(z_t, mu_{s_t}) + lambda_J * sum_t 1(s_t != s_{t-1})
jm_model.loss_scale_L: train-only median finite one-centroid (grand-mean) loss on the current calibration window, same standardization the fit itself uses
jm_model.raw_prehistory_shortfall_note: measured against the registered earliest usable BTCUSDT date 2020-01-06 (registration.json data_role_exception.measured_full_interval): exactly 4 of the 12 INIT origins (2020-07-04, 2020-08-29, 2020-10-24, 2020-12-19) fall short and get a typed INSUFFICIENT_RAW_PREHISTORY status, no fabricated state; all 12 VALIDATION origins (>=2022-05-14) clear it
jm_model.refit_policy: fresh, independent fit at EVERY fixed selection cutoff, never a shared/rolling fit across origins; centroids from a later origin never overwrite an earlier origin's already-recorded state
jm_model.standardization: train-only mean/std (per-fit, over that origin's own 180-day calibration window), frozen for that fit; never fit on the full dataset

solver.fit_algorithm: coordinate descent: (a) full forward+backward Viterbi decode of the whole calibration batch given frozen centroids (E-step, legitimate since the WHOLE 180-day window is already 'past' relative to the origin cutoff), (b) recompute centroids as the mean of assigned points (M-step), repeat to convergence or max_iter
solver.emitted_state_algorithm: a SEPARATE, strictly forward-only causal filter (state[t] = argmin_k cost[t][k], cost built only from z[1..t]) applied to the FROZEN, already-fit centroids -- never the batch Viterbi path, so the tape can never encode information from a bar after t (guide: 'filtered decision theo past, khong smoothed/backtracked')
solver.convergence_criterion: state path unchanged between iterations OR max centroid shift < tolerance

jm_model.vintage_identity: one independent causal tape per (origin, penalty recipe c) -- 'emit decision tape bat bien theo tung prefix': a historical origin's own recorded state is NEVER retroactively rewritten by a later origin's fit

candidate_descriptor_and_contrast_model.candidate_pool_scope: PANEL-ONLY (owner decision dec-c94ea602aeac0f1a, 2026-09-25) -- B/C/R_RULE select among the SAME <=16-candidate representative panel + anchor SD-01/SD-02's own archive already forward-evaluates at each origin, NOT the full raw ~100-115-candidate unique-candidate pool. Revises protocol_migration.json F03b's 'full pool' disposition (scope_revision_sd02_20260925, original text preserved). Avoids an estimated ~10h of new, undisclosed real engine compute (real per-candidate IS-window evaluate_candidate calls for the full pool).
candidate_descriptor_and_contrast_model.descriptor_fidelity_note: because scope is panel-only, every scored candidate's descriptor is FULL REAL FIDELITY (canonical 180-day evaluate_candidate IS Sharpe + a real activity/support entry count from the SAME call) -- no proxy/approximation was needed for any candidate that IS scored.

z_feature_definitions.norm_*: schema-normalized effective A-SC parameters via fp.selector_b.normalized_params (declared-bounds [0,1] normalization, reused verbatim)
z_feature_definitions.is_daily_sharpe: canonical raw IS Sharpe (180-day window, sd.metrics.window_sharpe), NOT the search's cheap mean_is_sharpe_search_proxy
z_feature_definitions.activity_entries: real entry (trade) count from the SAME IS-window evaluate_candidate call, exposed via sd/archive.py's candidate_window_sharpe (SD02.1 addition) for freshly-built VALIDATION origins, backfilled via a guaranteed cache-HIT re-fetch (sd/candidate_descriptors.py) for SD-01's already-committed INIT origins

candidate_descriptor_and_contrast_model.contrast_vector: v = phi(z_candidate) - phi(z_anchor); phi = train-only standardizer with a fixed constant-column-drop rule (sd/contrast_features.py)
candidate_descriptor_and_contrast_model.model_B: no-intercept weighted ridge on v (sd/ridge_contrast.py); weight_i = 1/n_origin(i) so every origin contributes total weight 1 (guide SS5.5 point 1); objective = sum_origin(mean_candidate_squared_error) + lambda_global*||beta||^2, lambda_global=10.0
candidate_descriptor_and_contrast_model.model_C: state-specific residual correction gamma_state fit on Y - Y_hat_B, SAME contrast vector v, SAME weighted-ridge objective, lambda_state=10.0; support floor >=3 distinct matured origins per state else correction=0 (GLOBAL_FALLBACK/STATE_SUPPORT_LOW)
candidate_descriptor_and_contrast_model.global_support_floor: B needs >=12 distinct matured train origins at every decision (mbc.MIN_GLOBAL_TRAIN_ORIGINS)
candidate_descriptor_and_contrast_model.self_discovered_defect_avoided: SELF01_RIDGE_INTERCEPT -- fp/selector_b.py's own fit_ridge/predict_ridge are NOT reused (they de-mean y and fit a separate un-penalized intercept); sd/ridge_contrast.py is a fresh, intercept-free implementation verified via S1-T04-style anchor-zero and independent-objective-minimization tests

r_rule_comparator.state_rule: HIGH_VOL iff origin's own log_rv_ratio_28_180 (the SAME raw feature JM's own tape computes, read off z_raw's last calibration row) >= a per-fold threshold
r_rule_comparator.threshold_fit: median of log_rv_ratio_28_180 over the SAME chronologically-matured training origins B used at that fold (causal, permitted-past only, refit EVERY fold -- never a single fixed threshold across the whole study)
r_rule_comparator.correction_architecture: IDENTICAL to model_C (same fit_model_c/predict_c call), only the state SOURCE differs

chronology_guard.reused_verbatim: fp.chronology.chronological_split / fp.forward_ledger.training_view -- guide migration finding F02's own remedy; no second, parallel causality check built for SD
chronology_guard.label_available_at: origin_cutoff + 56 days (the FWD window's own end -- when relative_decay_Y genuinely becomes knowable)
chronology_guard.boundary_rule: STRICT: a label is usable only if available BEFORE (not at-or-before) the decision time -- inherited from chronological_split's own '>=' blocked condition

arms.A_M4: the search's own installed-selector pick (the anchor) -- no model, trivially eligible
arms.B_SD_GLOBAL: minY selection over model_B's predictions on the panel
arms.R_RULE: minY selection over model_C predictions, state from the volatility-threshold rule
arms.JM_C0.5 / JM_C1.0 / JM_C2.0: minY selection over model_C predictions, state from each penalty recipe's own causal JM tape

recipe_selection_rule.primary_criterion: mean validation R = D_B - D_C, MAXIMIZED among technically-valid designs (>=12 paired-valid folds); R>0 is NOT required
recipe_selection_rule.tie_break: within 1e-6 Sharpe points, prefer the larger c, then a deterministic arm name -- never the final OOS result
